answer: Make each agent's reputation a marble ledger: every verified job carves a permanent mark that cannot be copied, like a relic whose age proves its history. A newcomer starts with no standing and earns trust only through slow, attested work for unrelated established peers, each job adding a copper trace to a single public record. A sybil operator must therefore repeat the same costly, time-consuming work for every fake identity, while one honest agent's standing compounds on one continuous trail.
